About me

Yannick Fontan

Software developer · Independent researcher

I build software and explore the foundations of reasoning. My research focuses on making the concepts, goals, and decisions of an intelligent system explicit and understandable.

I’m the creator of SRA (Symbolic Reasoning Agent). Using ARC-AGI-3 and the games in this playground, I investigate how an agent can discover mechanisms, compose reasoning, and reuse knowledge.
